title: Neuroepo multisession Phase II and III
description: A randomized, placebo-controlled clinical trial investigating the neuroprotective and neuromodulatory effects of intranasal NeuroEPO (erythropoietin) in Parkinson's disease patients. The dataset comprises multisession EEG recordings and clinical assessments collected at baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months post-intervention, with the goal of examining whether NeuroEPO-related cognitive and motor effects are mediated by changes in EEG source activity. This Phase II/III study provides evidence for functional brain reorganization mechanisms underlying EPO treatment in neurodegenerative disease.
methods_description: Participants were enrolled in a randomized, placebo-controlled design with NeuroEPO administered intranasally according to protocol (Cuban Public Registry RPCEC00000233-En) or placebo. Clinical and EEG assessments were conducted at baseline (pre-intervention) and 9 months post-intervention. Motor performance was assessed using the Unified Parkinson Disease Rating Scale MDS UPDRS III by certified neurologists. Baseline demographic and clinical characteristics included age, education, disease duration, and motor severity.
